question:
**Select the option with the correct spellings to replace the underlined words in the given sentence. **

The __enchanteng scenary__ of the beautiful lake was mesmerising.
solution:
The correct answer is: **enchanting; scenery**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Enchanting**" is the correct spelling, replacing "**enchanteng**."
 
• "**Scenery**" is the correct spelling, replacing "**scenary**."
 
• **Enchanting**: Having the quality of charming or fascinating; capturing one's attention in a delightful way. (**अद्भुत**)
 
• **Scenery**: The natural features or landscape of a place, especially considered in terms of their visual appeal. (**प्राकृतिक दृश्य**)
 
 
• **Example**: *As they reached the mountaintop, the group was captivated by the **enchanting scenery**, with breathtaking views of valleys and snow-capped peaks.*
 
 
 
• **Corrected sentence**: The enchanting scenery of the beautiful lake was mesmerising.
 
• The corrected sentence uses the appropriate spellings "*enchanting*" and "*scenery*" to accurately describe the captivating and visually appealing landscape of the beautiful lake.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
